description: DE-Pack: the declining-balance rule reintroduced for movable assets acquired between 1 July 2025 and 31 December 2027 — factor 3, capped at 30 % (§ 7 Abs. 2 EStG). The mechanism lives in the core and is shared; what the pack carries is the factor, the cap and above all the WINDOW, which is the most short-lived kind of number a pack holds: this one lasts two and a half years. An acquisition outside it gets no invented rate — asking for the method is E_PACK_INCOHERENT rather than a silent fallback to a figure the core made up. Here a machine bought in January 2026 with a five-year life: min(3 x 20 %, 30 %) = 30 %, so 36,000.00 x 30 % = 10,800.00 in the first year against 7,200.00 straight line.
